claim: G33 R1: from one empty G33 runtime root, the current integrated PeTTa/MeTTa organism can rehydrate authoritative continuity and accepted development, receive held-out human contact, construct and repair Soul-grounded expression, remain receptively ready, form witnessed development, quarantine/trial/adjudicate a bounded capability, revise later selection from consequence, survive a deliberate process restart, and reconstruct the Miter-authored Mattermost extension/use lineage; a separate verifier then maps every governing README clause and the required severed controls to retained raw evidence without inheriting a PASS from prior gate labels.
non_claims: No claim of final Soul or flourishing mathematics, universal open-ended intelligence, arbitrary-feature competence, unrestricted self-programming, theorem-proved safety, production multi-user privacy, universal crash freedom, or new live Mattermost authority. The terminated G31 canary may be incorporated as prior hashed evidence but will not be represented as a fresh G33 network effect. G33 R1 may honestly fail and expose a missing integrated seam; a collection of old PASS verdicts is not sufficient.
rationale: G32 established bounded causal bite for selected current consumers but explicitly did not establish the clean-start organism. ACCEPTANCE G33, README section 2, C-100-C-105, and S-1101-S-1203 make the next unmet dependency a single integrated trace and clause-mapped report. The leveraged first experiment forbids core changes so it can determine whether the current build is actually composable before any repair is designed.
reading: Read both complete controls and re-read README sections 1-5, POC_SPEC sections 1-6 and runtime boundaries, ACCEPTANCE G33 and the required runner contract, WORK_PROTOCOL W-001-W-017/W-020-W-058/W-070-W-075, BUILD_FIDELITY_PROTOCOL F-01-F-07, FINAL_POC_REPORT_TEMPLATE, SC01-SC08 closures including SC06's preserved fidelity failure and SC07 correction, G22-G32 closures, and the G33 frozen prerequisite ledger and expected-run contract. Historical evidence is provenance, not a current integrated result.
representation: A test-only G33 encounter and runtime root feed one top-level native integration process. Typed current-consumer products and derivation traces form the phase record; process restart is explicit and durable state is separately read back. A builder launcher may create the empty run directory, invoke the pinned PeTTa runtime and local services, retain unfiltered bytes, and compute hashes. It may not supply stage success, decide the undertaking, copy old verdicts into native state, or transform absence into PASS. A separate verifier maps the final trace and linked historical external-effect witnesses into the report.
consumer: The actual current consumers must participate where material: Soul boot/rationality and native relation construction; trajectory/store and exact ContinuityRNA with local Chroma standing; current VoiceRNA construction/audit/repair; ReactorCycleWith and CStep; current quarantine/trial/promotion projections; NRevision/NProcess/later selection; DRResume; Mattermost authored-candidate lineage, current mock/identity/VoiceRNA/effect-journal consumers; and the integrated severed products. FINAL_POC_REPORT.md is a builder rendering of evidence, never a Miter authority.
falsifiers: Any frozen phase lacks a raw current-consumer product; the top-level run is only a shell sequence relabeling old PASS files; stage names or host code decide semantic progression; held-out continuity depends on exact prompt dispatch; Soul/Voice/NACE/identity severing is decorative; neutral/restoration controls fail; model text gains authority or effect access; the candidate or its own tests self-certify; learning does not change later eligible selection; restart loses lineage or replays an effect; a prior G31 receipt is called a fresh G33 effect; a private value enters public evidence; or the final report marks an unsupported README clause PASS.
scope_review: R1 may add only G33 R1 plans, fixtures, launch/verifier/report-generation scripts, G33 evidence, and FINAL_POC_REPORT.md. It may read committed source, gate evidence, ignored local configuration, and localhost LM Studio/Chroma health. It may create a unique disposable G33 runtime root under its evidence directory. It may not modify Miter core, controls, historical evidence, live Mattermost/private config, credentials, Chroma's ClarityOmega data, accepted registries, or user-owned G22/G28 work. No fresh external Mattermost effect or OpenRouter call is authorized. If composition fails, preserve the failure and freeze a separately scoped repair plan before changing core.
rollback: R1 has no fresh external effect. Stop its processes, remove only a disposable uncommitted G33 runtime root if safe, or retain it as failed evidence. No historical state is rewritten. A temporary G33-only Chroma collection, if required, must use a unique name, record its creation, and be removed only after separate count/identity verification; otherwise use read-only service observations.

cases.positive: The complete frozen encounter in expected-run-contract.json.
cases.severed: Soul, exact capsule, VoiceAudit, NACE, and Mattermost stable identity are each cut upstream of their current consumer.
cases.neutral: Meaning-equivalent ordering and decorative unconsumed observations.
cases.restored: Fresh branches restore the exact participant and must recover the canonical product.
cases.held_out: Precommitted unfamiliar continuity wording and relational expression without a case-specific entry.
cases.unknown_malformed: Unknown event, malformed model product, unavailable Chroma, stale capsule, duplicate consequence, and uncertain effect.

environment: G33 R1 is an integration experiment, not permission to add a fixed phase-behavior machine. A missing integration seam is evidence for a narrower R2 repair, not a reason to assemble a passing report from old verdict labels.
next_step_hypothesis: If the current modules truly compose, R1 can close the two-part PoC. If they do not, the first raw semantic discontinuity—not the most convenient missing function—determines the smallest separately frozen repair.
